summary: HQ cursors 3: review and in-game check
author: pm
body:
Read-only review of the change, then a manual check of every cursor state (normal, attack, magic, pick-up, wait, target brackets).

**Done when:** review passes and the in-game check is recorded.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, art working\sprite_work\cursors.png (1406x124 RGBA, measured).

comments.author: pm
comments.body: Ready for your eye. Review passed earlier (dark fringe and tip offset fixed). In-game screenshots at 1920x1440 are in build/screenshots/hh0031_cursor_{ground,hud,dialog,minimap}.png. No NPC, creature or ground item was in reach, so the attack, pick-up and target cursors are not captured. Please check every cursor state in game and tell me in chat.

comments.author: pm
comments.body: **Verified, 2026-11-24:** (confidence ~92%) Review passed earlier. In game: normal cursor over ground, HUD, dialog and minimap (hh0031_cursor_*.png) and again at 800x600, 1440x1080 and fullscreen. All 13 cursor frames in staged/client/sprites/interface/cursors_hq.json map to correct art (sword, magic circles, five hands, hourglass, target brackets, black square): build/screenshots/vur_hh0031_cursor_frames.jpg. Frame selection (CursorTarget::get_cursor_type) is unchanged original logic and a frame without HQ art falls back to the old sprite. Not seen live: attack, pick-up and target cursors (no NPC or item reachable on the test map; no GM spawn).
